name: pour-contents
title: Pour contents into a container
description: Hold the cup's far lip over a container, turn the cup about that lip up to 90 deg and return it upright; succeeds when at least half of the loose items that were in the cup are inside the target. A rim-held cup tilts away from the pinch; a handle-held cup rolls sideways about the forearm.
use_when: Loose contents of a held container must go into another container.

not_to_be_confused_with.drop: drop releases the held object itself; pour tips out its contents.

source.description: The held cup or mug with loose items.

applicability.summary: Requires holding(hand=right, object=$source); base_near(place=$target); uncovered(container=$target); not container_empty(container=$source).

preconditions.name: holding
preconditions.meaning: The object is in the given gripper: fingers not shut, TCP-to-body distance unchanged since the grasp.
preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

preconditions.name: base_near
preconditions.meaning: Base centre within 1.3 m of the place's footprint (inside the room for a room).
preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

preconditions.name: uncovered
preconditions.meaning: No lid rests on the container rim.
preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

preconditions.name: container_empty
preconditions.meaning: No annotated object is inside the container.
preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

postconditions.name: poured_into
postconditions.meaning: At least half of the items that were inside the source are now inside the target.
postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

postconditions.name: holding
postconditions.meaning: The object is in the given gripper: fingers not shut, TCP-to-body distance unchanged since the grasp.
postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

previous.when: food is poured into the opened pot

next.when: the empty cup is put down

fallback.when: the target has its lid on

fallback_for.when: the food is in a cup, not in the pot on the burner

failure.on_failure: stop; return every measured predicate, the completed policy steps and the fallback skills whose repaired predicate failed; the planner chooses what to do. Inside a multi-object node a nested call that fails a precondition with a matching repair fallback runs that repair once and retries.
